description.blurb: 4450 Pan is a highly eccentric asteroid classified as a near-Earth object of the Apollo group, approximately 1.1 kilometers in diameter.
description.more: As an Apollo asteroid, it is an Earth-crosser and has a minimum orbit intersection distance with Earth of 0.0287 AU (4,290,000 km), which corresponds to 11.2 lunar distances. Due to its extremely eccentric orbit, it is also a Venus- and Mars-crosser and approaches Mercury as well.
